Fast Charging at up to 22.5W.Fast charge your mobile devices with Monoprice Ultra‑Compact & Slim 10,000mAh Power Bank. It is one of the smallest 10,000mAh power banks in the market (at just 4.2" x 2.7" x 0.6"), yet packs enough power to give 2-3 full charges (0 to 100%) for smart phones.
